summary: Nebius Group N.V. filed a Form 6-K announcing the closing of its acquisition of MagicByte, Inc. (d/b/a Eigen AI Labs). The transaction was initially announced on May 1, 2026, and closed on June 10, 2026, after obtaining required regulatory approvals and satisfying customary closing conditions. No financial terms (price per share, premium, or consideration type) were disclosed in the filing. The board's recommendation and advisor names were not mentioned. The acquisition closed swiftly within about six weeks, suggesting a straightforward structure. What to watch: any subsequent integration updates and potential impact on Nebius's AI cloud platform; no risk-arb spread exists as the deal is closed.
